preconditions.description: The number of days (m) and stores (n) are within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= s_i <= n-1 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for s_i in [int(line.split()[0])])
preconditions.description: Each day, Dora buys between 1 and n-1 distinct store indices (s_i).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= store_idx <= n for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for store_idx in [int(x) for x in line.split()[1:]])
preconditions.description: All store indices Dora buys from are within the valid range [1, n].

preconditions.expression: all(len(set(store_indices)) == len(store_indices) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for store_indices in [[int(x) for x in line.split()[1:]]])
preconditions.description: Dora's store indices per day are distinct (no duplicates).

postconditions.expression:
stdout.strip() == 'possible' if and only if all(
    any(
        all(a_dora > 0 for a_dora in a_dora_set) and
        all(a_swiper > 0 for a_swiper in a_swiper_set) and
        lcm(a_dora_set) > lcm(a_swiper_set)
        for a_dora_set in product(*[range(1, max_a+1) for _ in range(n)]) if
            (a_dora_set := [a_dora_set[i] for i in range(n) if (i+1) in dora_stores]) and
            (a_swiper_set := [a_dora_set[i] for i in range(n) if (i+1) not in dora_stores])
    )
    for dora_stores in [set(int(x) for x in line.split()[1:]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]]
) else False
postconditions.description: The output is 'possible' if and only if there exists a positive integer assignment for all stores (a_1, ..., a_n) such that for every day, the LCM of Dora's chosen stores' values is strictly greater than the LCM of Swiper's chosen stores' values. The LCM is computed over the positive integers assigned to the respective stores.
